text:
Maya Chen: @here customer 'AcmePay' escalated — per-model throughput sparkline panels in Console show zeros for all models since ~01:58 UTC. They say API traffic fine but dashboard looks dead.
Alex Rivera: yep saw that alert, panels in /dashboards/inference/models show flat 0 for model_qps_* series. No related 5xxs.
deploy-bot: deployed exporter-service v2.1.0 to prod in eu-west-1 at 01:57:44 UTC (sha: ab12cd).
Jon Patel: quick check of the exported metrics — exporter v2.1.0 renamed label key from "model_name" to "model_id" as part of the refactor. Grafana queries and Prometheus recording rules still expect "model_name" so series don't match.
Liam O'Connor: confirmed. Prometheus now scraping metric 'inference_model_qps' with label model_id="redwood-llama-7b" but dashboards use "model_name=~" filters so panels evaluate to empty.
Nina Park: customer also mentioned billing spikes in the same window but backend usage shows tokens and requests normal; looks like a telemetry-only problem (console/alerts misleading). I've told CS to hold billing escalation.
Alex Rivera: short repro:
```
# promtool query series
inference_model_qps{job="exporter",model_id=~".*"}
```
returns series, but query with model_name returns nothing.
Jon Patel: quick mitigation — add a relabel to Prometheus scrape to copy model_id -> model_name (temporary). YAML to apply to prometheus.yml: 
```
- job_name: exporter
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_exporter_model_id"]
    target_label: "model_name"
    action: replace
```
(our Prometheus exposes exporter metadata labels under __meta_exporter_*).
Liam O'Connor: or use a PromQL recording rule to create legacy-label series: `label_replace(inference_model_qps, "model_name", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")` — faster to roll out via ruler. I'll push a short recording rule to staging then prod.
deploy-bot: prometheus config reload requested at 02:12:03 UTC, reload ok.
Maya Chen: panels are starting to show data again. Paging AcmePay support contact that dashboards look normal now.
Jon Patel: follow-up actions — (1) add compatibility bridge in exporter so it emits both model_id and model_name for 2 weeks, (2) update dashboard queries to prefer model_id, (3) add entry in release notes about label rename, (4) postmortem + retro. I'll own (1) and (4). Creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4721.
Nina Park: noted — I'll update the CS thread and confirm billing not impacted.
Alex Rivera: thumbs up. Also we should add a linter check in ci that prevents label key renames without a migration plan.
Jon Patel: adding that to the postmortem doc.
Maya Chen: thanks team. Closing the escalation once CS confirms customer sees charts. :white_check_mark:
